failure.explanation: The historical exception was raised by stamp_source_blocks after the simplified author call returned and before Chromium render/readback. The old AuthoredStageError wrapper omitted BrowserSourceReadbackError.detail, so the retained checkpoint cannot distinguish no exact DOM match from conflicting or duplicate binding integrity; it does prove this was not a browser visibility or telemetry rejection.

priorFailureFinding: BrowserSourceReadbackError subclasses ValueError, but the deferral logger used type(error).__name__; therefore these three recorded names were base ValueError instances, not per-attempt BrowserSourceReadbackError instances. Their messages and rejected HTML existed only in the in-memory AuthoredBatchFailure and were not written to the checkpoint or log.

readOnlyCheckpointProbe.method: Read-StackEnvironment wrapper with SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY

implementedRouting.visibilityOnly: canonical inspect_browser_source_readback result becomes a predeclared verbatim_flag_only entry only when source-reflow terminal fallback is active
implementedRouting.hardReadback: missing, order, integrity, telemetry, and diagnostic failures raise AuthoredStageError with source_content_browser_readback_failed, the bounded detail, block IDs, provider attempt count, and prior author failure
implementedRouting.observability: source_content_browser_readback_failed is allowlisted and no longer collapses to authored_unexpected_failure
implementedRouting.priorValueErrors: new runs classify bounded reasons and carry the original sanitized ValueError reason into failure or flagged-slide receipt evidence
